Disk Monitor / 硬盘监控 —— 首次打开说明 / How to open the first time
=====================================================================

【中文】

1. 把“DiskMonitor”拖到旁边的“Applications（应用程序）”文件夹。
2. 第一次打开时，系统可能提示“无法验证开发者”或“Apple 无法检查其是否包含恶意软件”。
   这是因为本应用没有经过 Apple 公证，并不代表应用有问题。放行方法：

   macOS 15 及以上：
     先双击打开一次 → 出现提示后点“完成” →
     打开“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”，在页面下方找到“DiskMonitor 已被阻止”，点“仍要打开”，
     再输入开机密码确认。

   macOS 10.15 – 14：
     在“应用程序”文件夹里，按住 Control 键点按 DiskMonitor（或右键）→ 选“打开” → 再点“打开”。

   如果提示“已损坏，无法打开”，在“终端”里运行下面这行命令后再打开：
     xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/DiskMonitor.app

3. 打开后应用只出现在屏幕右上角的状态栏里，不会出现在程序坞（Dock）中。
   点击状态栏图标即可查看详情、切换语言、设置开机自动启动。

【English】

1. Drag "DiskMonitor" into the "Applications" folder next to it.
2. The app is not notarized by Apple, so macOS may block it the first time.
   This does not mean anything is wrong with the app. To allow it:

   macOS 15 or later:
     Double-click the app once and click "Done" in the warning →
     open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down to
     "DiskMonitor was blocked", click "Open Anyway" and confirm with your password.

   macOS 10.15 – 14:
     In the Applications folder, Control-click (or right-click) DiskMonitor →
     choose "Open" → click "Open" again.

   If macOS says the app "is damaged", run this in Terminal, then open it again:
     xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/DiskMonitor.app

3. The app lives only in the menu bar (top-right of the screen), not in the Dock.
   Click its menu bar icon for details, language, and launch-at-login settings.
